responding_to.type: bus passengers trapped by rising water

output.english: This is a SIMULATED flood exercise for Richmond, VA. Rising water is reported in Shockoe Bottom and Riverside Apartments, with closed roads at Dock St and Lee Bridge. Stay away from these places; next steps are unknown.
output.spanish: Este es un ejercicio SIMULADO de inundación para Richmond, VA. Hay agua en Shockoe Bottom y Riverside Apartments, y calles cerradas en Dock St y Lee Bridge. No vaya a estos lugares; los próximos pasos son desconocidos.
